# meok-mcp-cardgen-mcp

> MEOK MCP Cardgen — generate signed .well-known MCP server cards (SEP-1649 + SEP-1960 + SEP-2127). Claude Desktop 2.1 + Cursor 2026.4 auto-discover servers via these. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- emit_sep_1649_card
- emit_sep_1960_card
- emit_sep_2127_card
- emit_all_cards
- validate_card
- sign_card
- list_shapes

## Install
```
pip install meok-mcp-cardgen-mcp
```

- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/meok-mcp-cardgen-mcp/
